testcase.name: Scenario: Preview and reset an incremental view rotation: tmp/obk-orbit-48987af/features/application/viewport-orbit/viewport-orbit.feature:35:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Preview and reset an incremental view rotation ✔ Given a rectangular block is visible face-on in an active part in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user chooses Rotate at Angle from the orbit menu ✔ Then an incremental view rotation dialog opens ✔ And it contains an increment field, six direction buttons, Reset, OK and Cancel ✔ And the increment field displays 10 ✔ When the user clicks the first direction button ✔ Then the visible view changes while the dialog remains open ✔ When the user clicks Reset ✔ Then the original face-on view is restored ✔ When the user clicks the first direction button again ✔ And the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the original face-on view is restored ✔ And the status area displays Ready
